Description
These 5 oz secondary market silver bars can be obtained for far less than newly minted silver bars, making them a very cost-effective solution. Many of these
5 oz Silver bars
, which are minted by both private and sovereign mints, are easily identified and exchanged by bullion dealers around the world.
Each of these 5 oz Secondary market silver bars can be a great choice to diversify your precious metal portfolio at a reasonable premium over the spot price. All of these 5 oz secondary market silver bars are inspected, tested, and refilled by professionals to ensure the authenticity and purity of the silver.
These secondary market silver bars might show some small signs of aging, handling, and toning. However, these bars are still regarded as quality products that will fetch you a higher price when compared to the original bars of new condition which are available with the mint.
With each purchase of these 5 oz Silver Bar – Secondary Market, you will be receiving the silver bullion bar that contains 5 troy oz of
.999 fine silver
.
Unlike other
Silver Bullion bars
in the market, you will find that there is absolutely no difference between the size or the weight of these silver bars.
These Silver 5 oz bars are made by various manufacturers, including Credit Suisse, PAMP Suisse, Johnson Matthey, Engelhard, and Perth Mint, among others.
Buying the silver bars of this allows you to add the silver bars of different brands to your precious metal portfolio and enjoy the benefit of owning silver at a lower premium.
Your order may include the 5 oz silver bar of a single design or a variety of designs depending on the stock available on our inventory.
Design of 5 oz Secondary Market Silver Bars
As these silver bars are from the secondary market, the mint of origin and design of these 5 oz silver bars will be randomized on the basis of availability on our inventory. Order of multiple secondary market silver bars may contain single or varying designs.
Main Highlights of 5 oz Silver Bar – Secondary Market
Contains 5 troy oz of .999 fine silver.
Produced by the Recognized Private or Sovereign Mint
Low Premium over the spot price
Individual Silver bars come in protective plastic flips.
The obverse and reverse of these 5 oz silver bars vary depending on the bar you receive.
